name: Imp

actions.name: Poison Sting
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be poisoned for 1 minute.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.effect: The Imp turns invisible until it attacks or loses concentration.

reactions.name: Shapeshift Escape
reactions.effect: When hit, the Imp shifts into a rat, raven, or spider and scurries up to 6m away. +3 to defenses against the triggering attack.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Can polymorph into a rat, raven, or spider, or back to its true form. Stats remain the same.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Can see perfectly in magical and non-magical darkness up to 36m.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: +1d6 to saves against spells and magical effects.

lore: Imps are small, devious devils that serve as familiars, messengers, and spies for more powerful fiends and mortal warlocks. They are patient corruptors, whispering temptations and keeping careful records of their master's sins.
